item.title: [Tamil] [OTT Release] Mandaadi
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTamil
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date08 Oct 2026 (OTT)

Set in the coastal towns of Ramanathapuram and Tuticorin, Mandaadi revolves around the high-stakes sport of sailboat racing, a practice deeply embedded in the local culture. The film focuses on the intense rivalry between two teams, led by Soori's character and his opponent, played by Suhas. The narrative explores themes of passion, perseverance, and redemption against the backdrop of thrilling sea races.

item.title: [Tamil] [OTT Release] Paris Cafe
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTamil
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date09 Oct 2026 (OTT)

A dream trip turns bittersweet when Olivizhiyaal learns her parents, Dr. Gautam Raja and Thara, have separated. A buried secret and a photograph in a Paris caf bring the past crashing back. With soulmate Kavin Samson by her side, Oli uncovers a hidden sin and a chance for redemption. Will forgiveness light the way?
